title: NZ Family Holiday Planner — Personalised Trip Recommender
description: Tell us about your family — kids' ages, interests, how long you have — and get three personalised NZ holiday recommendations with activity picks and cost guides.
meta_desc: Get a personalised NZ family holiday plan in minutes. Tell us your family's ages and interests and we'll recommend the perfect destination with activities and cost estimates.
html_content:
Answer a few quick questions about your family and get three personalised NZ holiday recommendations — with activity picks, cost guides, and destination links.

Start planning →

faq.question: How does the NZ Family Holiday Planner work?
faq.answer: Answer a few quick questions about your family — kids' ages, interests, and how long you have — and the tool returns three personalised NZ holiday recommendations with activity picks and cost guides.

faq.question: Do I need to create an account to use the planner?
faq.answer: No — it's a free, instant tool. Just answer the questions and get your recommendations straight away, no sign-up required.

faq.question: What information does the planner use to make recommendations?
faq.answer: Your family's ages, interests, and available trip length, matched against our destination guides and cost data to suggest three suitable NZ holiday options.

faq.question: Can I use the planner for a short weekend trip as well as a longer holiday?
faq.answer: Yes — the planner asks how long you have and tailors its three recommendations to that timeframe, whether it's a long weekend or a multi-week trip.
